Un marcha-paro desde cero: etapas, trans: A start-stop from scratch: steps, transitions, an action, a loop, Check and simulate.
Un número por red equipotencial (los de: One number per equipotential net (busbar ones, their potential)
Un proyecto puede tener varias hojas, co: A project can have several sheets, like a drawing set: + adds one and double-clicking its tab renames it.
Un pulsador cualquiera enciende la escal: Any push button switches on the staircase light; timer KT1 switches it off by itself after 30 s.
Un solo devanado: KM1 da la velocidad le: Single winding: KM1 gives low speed (delta, via 1U-1V-1W); KM2 with KM3 (which bridges 1U-1V-1W) gives high speed (double star, via 2U-2V-2W). Interlocked: never both at once.
Un tubo de aire solo une conexiones neum: An air tube only joins pneumatic ports (and a wire, electrical terminals).
Una acción continua asigna la salida en: A continuous action assigns the output at every instant (1 while the step is active, 0 otherwise); a stored action leaves it at a value until another one changes it. Mixing both on the same output makes the continuous one override the stored one. Choose a single kind for each output.
Una entrada comparada con números (Tempe: An input compared with numbers (Temperature > 60) is analog. In Variables you choose its signal (4–20 mA or 0–10 V) and its physical range; the simulation uses a slider in those units. In the PLC program, comparisons with numbers use the precomputed raw value (e.g. AIW0 > 21760); comparing two analogs (Weight >= Setpoint) or calculating with them (Speed := Setpoint / 2) is scaled in the PLC, in REAL.
Una etapa con varias transiciones altern: A step with several alternative transitions: single line under the step.
Una etapa encapsulante (esquinas cortada: An enclosing step (cut corners) has its enclosed grafcet in a frame: when it is activated, the steps with an activation link (*) are activated; when it is deactivated, everything enclosed is. Right-click a step > Convert to enclosing step.
A receptivity of 0 blocks the sequence. Write the condition that must be met to advance.
Una receptividad describe lo que se espe: A receptivity describes what is expected from the process: usually inputs (sensors, push buttons) or the state of other steps (X3). An output is set by the grafcet itself, so waiting for it is usually an oversight: use the sensor that confirms the order has been carried out. If it is an internal flag, change its type to “Memory” in Variables.
Una transición que activa varias etapas: A transition that activates several steps at once: double line.
Una transición sin etapa anterior (fuent: A transition with no preceding step (source) is always enabled: whenever its receptivity is true, usually an edge (↑Part), it activates the following steps. A transition with no following step (sink) deactivates its preceding steps.
Unidad de mantenimiento (filtro, regulad: Service unit (filter, regulator and lubricator) with shut-off valve: when simulating, a click shuts off or supplies the air.
Validada y con la receptividad verdadera: Enabled and with a true receptivity: it is cleared in the next cycle.
Válvula distribuidora: la bobina 14 es u: Directional valve: coil 14 is a solenoid valve of the diagram (-Y1); without coil 12, it returns with its spring (monostable); with both, it stays where it is (bistable, memory).
Variables y operadores de la norma: a ·: Variables and the operators of the standard: a · b (AND), a + b (OR), !a (negation), ↑a / ↓a (edges), X2 (step 2 active), 5s/X2 (timing), [C >= 3] (comparison). As you type, autocomplete suggests the existing variables.
Variador de frecuencia: DI1 adelante, DI: Frequency drive: DI1 forward, DI2 reverse, DI3 2nd speed, AI1 setpoint 0-10 V (overrides the speeds). R1-R2 closes with the motor running. Its +24/GND supply the inputs.
Varios pulsadores en paralelo: cada puls: Several push buttons in parallel: each press of impulse relay KL1 toggles the lamp.
Ventosa sin vacío (no coge): Suction cup without vacuum (does not pick)
Ver la transición (pasa el ratón por ell: Show the transition (hover over it for details)
Verificar está en verde (✓): el grafcet: Check is green (✓): the grafcet complies with the standard. If something is missing, the button shows how many errors or warnings there are and each one explains what to do.
Vista de frente: las piezas caen y se ap: Front view: parts fall and rest on conveyors, platforms and other parts. Click to see it from above (no gravity)
Top view: parts do not fall. Click to see it from the front, with gravity
Vista en relieve: cada elemento con su v: Relief view: each element with its volume (only the drawing changes)
Visualizador: muestra el valor de una va: Display: shows the value of a variable (counter, analog…).
Vivienda: diferencial (Q1) y PIA (Q2), i: Dwelling: RCD (Q1) and MCB (Q2), switch S1 and lamp E1. Test the RCD with its T button.
Vuelve a asignar todas las direcciones e: Reassigns all addresses in order (can be undone)
X{etapa} no está activa: la temporizació: X{etapa} is not active: the timer is not counting
X2 vale 1 con la etapa 2 activa (IEC 608: X2 is 1 while step 2 is active (IEC 60848). In Variables you can choose for the table, the ladder, ST, STL and the simulation to use E2; in receptivities you still write X2 and 5s/X2.
Y en la wiki (en el índice), cada parte: And in the wiki (in the index), each part of the program with its why and how, examples that open in the editor and guided tutorials.
y pégalos en la tabla de símbolos (colum: and paste them into the symbol table (Symbol column). First scan: SM0.1.
Ya tiene transición. Para una alternativ: It already has a transition. For an OR alternative: right click on the transition
Ya tienes tu primer grafcet. Desactiva M: You now have your first grafcet. Switch Marcha off and Paro on: it goes back to step 0. Carry on with the wiki (Help) or open a level 1 example.
Zumba sin arrancar: falta el devanado au: Hums without starting: the auxiliary winding is missing
